review_text: Advertised as a "weeding tool" but does NOT work for that, unless you're weeding grass that is. Maybe thats what they meant? In either case they will try to get you with it being non-returnable. Don't waste your money if you're looking for a tool for working with vinyl. These are very large, cumbersome and not fit for detail work.

On the surface these corners are lovely. They have an antique stamped finish that provides an attractive corner.

These are glued on, not nailed-- which is great if you like working with epoxy, not so great if you prefer an authentic hammered-nail appearance (individual preference). There are no nail holes, nor nails included.

However there are several disadvantages to this product:

* It's not a true "corner" that covers the entire corner of the box. It is a stamp-cut and bent piece of sheet metal, leaving a v-grove in the corner and the corner side exposed.
* The corner is quite pointed and sharp-- so much so that it is not something I would choose to use again.
* This isn't one color, but is rather three slightly-different colors, approximating antique dull silver, gold and brass. That means if one wishes to do all 8 corners of a box the same color, you will need two sets of these corners. While it does say this in the *secondary* description, that information is not included in the main description. The color differences are very subtle (you can see it in the package photo if you look closely).
* The price on this item increased some 40% within one week.

Since boxes have 8 corners, it makes me wonder why they don't package these 8 or 16 in a pack and sell them in single colors. It seems this 12-corner 3-color set is designed either for projects that only use 4 corners, or to sell 2 packages at a time. I purchased 2 packages of these and was glad I did. Had I not I wouldn't have appreciated that vital information lacking in the main description and having to order a second package to complete my project.

General overall opinion: attractive but low-quality and SHARP (as in ouch) corners that require buying 2 sets to corner one box. As stamped and bent sheet metal I consider this over-priced. I will be opting for a little better-quality item next order. These are beautiful, but for a good box with "safe" corners, imo not the best option.

I have the Minc. I tried using it in different settings to see which would work best. The verdict says NONE. total waste of money. Ruined my cards. Donot buy. The tube sent is not as big as the ones from Minc.

Most of them stay together. Sometimes so well you can’t separate them. I didn’t receive enough of the pieces. Whomever is packaging are being lazy. They aren’t counting pieces. I used 15 sets so far and all I have left is 15 male pieces left  and I have 66 female pieces and 85 caps. There should be enough for 100 sets. Which means I should have 185 caps, 85 female and 85 male pieces remaining. Count the pieces when you get them and report shortage. I’ve used some so I can’t prove the shortage but I know what I have left and I’m going to run out of male pieces way before the other pieces. What a waste of money.  Now I have to order more to make up for the loss.

I had previously reviewed a set of markers that looked just like these, except that the photo for these showed iridescent tips suggesting that the ink would be shiny. The other markers were adequate, but the packing was flimsy. I thought for twice the price, these would surely be an upgrade. Not. When they arrived I was shocked to see that they are exactly the same product for double the price. That said, they are a decent marker with great vibrant colors. Complaints are that the tip of the smaller end doesn't stick to the end of the pen and the flimsy packaging. And in this case, the 100% markup.
